reporting.test_results: sealed on storage1 until manual signal, bank and Fixed-best freeze; no test/all-split summaries before freeze

sampling.allocation: Hamilton largest remainder proportional to sequence length

corruption.quantization: clip to [0,1], multiply by 255, np.rint, uint8
corruption.strength_convention: one published setting per corruption; no invented severity sweep
corruption.noise: NumPy PCG64; independent per RGB element, eye and frame; stable across models and assignment repetitions

brightness.convention: literal Eq.4 addition in RGB; HSV V ancestor ambiguity explicitly retained

contrast.center: per-image, per-channel spatial mean, float64 accumulation

saturation.conversion: OpenCV float RGB-HSV-RGB; H degrees, S/V [0,1]

speckle_noise.convention: I + I * sigma * independent standard normal HWC

metrics.valid: all four native-grid GT candidates finite; zero disparity retained
metrics.error: min over four absolute errors, GT already in native image pixel units
metrics.D1: error > 3 AND error > 0.05 * max(abs(four GT candidates))
metrics.primary_aggregation: sum sufficient statistics over all valid pixels; six-corruption macro excludes clean
metrics.secondary_support: all four GT candidates finite and 0 <= d < 192, both models

analysis_cache.subset_rule: shared ordered pool; nested prefix by default; optional seeded permutation within saved pool
analysis_cache.coordinates: one shared GT-valid x>=4 coordinate pool per pair, across models/conditions/signals
analysis_cache.common_support: GT-only uint8 mask stored once per pair alongside shared coordinates; secondary filtering of the chosen analysis prefix
analysis_cache.status: 50k storage plus 20k primary analysis explicitly adopted by user

metrics.table2_sample_mask: GT-valid, x >= 4 for both models; no masking based on score magnitude or error

table2.label: native D1
table2.aggregation: condition-specific pooled sampled pixels, then equal-weight six-corruption macro
table2.ci: sequence cluster bootstrap with fixed score histogram; exact point metrics and histogram approximation check

selection.secondary: maximum macro AP among AUROC practical ties
selection.tertiary: worst-corruption AUROC only for numerical AP ties; no practical AP tie band

broader_corruptions.source: notes/ROBUSTSPRING_CORRUPTIONS.md; configs/robustspring_aligned_v2.json; same v2 operator implementation
broader_corruptions.claim: RobustSpring-aligned controlled recipes, not exact official-generator pixels; no GT warp

gaussian_blur.implementation: OpenCV GaussianBlur RGB uint8, automatic kernel size (0,0), BORDER_REFLECT_101

jpeg_compression.implementation: Pillow JPEG RGB encode/decode, 4:2:0; record Pillow/libjpeg version

pixelate.implementation: Pillow BOX downsample then BOX restore native size; floor width/height separately, minimum 1

broader_corruptions.consistency: deterministic identical settings for both eyes and frames; content differs; no spatial coordinate warp or GT change

table3.generalization_policy: primary signal and Fixed-best frozen on original seven-condition dev domain; no refit on broader held-out conditions; exposure/gain action space unchanged
table3.report_aggregation: per seed/model/method: pooled native sufficient statistics for overall, clean, sensing_related, broader and each condition; additional equal-condition macro explicitly labeled
table3.claim: synthetic sensor-setting simulation, not hardware control

gain_noise.formula: linear signal * gain + Normal(0, sqrt((read_sigma*gain)^2 + shot_scale^2*gain*max(linear signal,0))); independent HWC noise

table3.assignment: balanced cyclic rotation after seeded pair and condition permutations; each pair sees five distinct conditions
table3.signal_aggregation: Signal-Global: mean across fixed-support pixels of within-pixel candidate ranks; lower risk ranks better; never mean raw risk

rank_selection.global_ties: seeded uniform among tied candidate IDs
rank_selection.seed_key: purpose/pair/incoming condition/model/primary signal; independent of assignment seed and loader order

dev_diagnostics.signal_pixel_ties: seeded uniform among exactly minimum-risk candidates
dev_diagnostics.pixel_oracle_objective: per-pixel minimum native absolute disparity error, not D1 argmin
report: Identity vs Global Oracle vs Pixel Oracle
full domain and shared signal support
dev_diagnostics.inclusion_decision: manual gate after dev diagnostics; no automatic protocol change

table3.fixed_best_objective: pooled dev D1, ties Abs then 1px then candidate ID
table3.fixed_best_dev_pair_scope: all dev pairs (328), after candidate-bank freeze; not just 24-pair bank sanity subset
table3.fixed_best_incoming_protocol: one condition per dev pair, balanced globally and within each sequence; separate fixed dev assignment
table3.fixed_best_near_tie_policy: report pooled D1 top-2 gap and condition-wise metrics; never auto-rerun seeds or change the winner
table3.oracle_objective: per-observation D1, ties Abs then 1px then candidate ID; diagnostic only
table3.execution: seed -> RAFT -> ACV -> publish seed report -> next seed; no automatic launch from Table 2

preflight.diagnostic_signal_status: plumbing fixtures only, not recommended/frozen primary signals

open_assumptions: 20k uniformly sampled pixels per pair for primary Table 2, adopted 50k saved pool; full pixels for Table 1; histogram CI approximation is explicitly checked
Signal selection support is input geometry x>=4, not GT validity; Signal-Pixel uses Identity outside it; Pixel Oracle evaluates all GT-valid pixels and additionally reports common support
